story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the Tall Nut Tree
story_info.subtitle: A Story About Trust
story_info.moral: Good friends help each other and build trust.

slides.title: A Morning in Maple Woods
slides.text: Oliver Fox loved his Maple Woods home. The morning sun felt warm and bright. He bounced through the green grass. He looked for fun things to do. Suddenly, he saw Squeaky Squirrel. Squeaky sat under a very tall tree. He looked a little sad. "Hello, Squeaky!" Oliver called out. "What is wrong?"
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver Fox is exploring Maple Woods on a bright morning. He spots his friend Squeaky Squirrel looking sad under a tall tree.

slides.title: Squeaky's Secret Tree
slides.text: Squeaky looked up at Oliver. "Oh, Oliver," Squeaky said softly. "My favorite nuts are up there. They are so sweet and yummy. But the tree is very tall. I am scared to climb so high. And it's my secret nut tree." He looked at Oliver, unsure.
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky Squirrel explains his problem to Oliver. He wants nuts from a tall tree but is afraid to climb and worried about his secret spot.

slides.title: Oliver's Clever Idea
slides.text: Oliver smiled. "I can help!" he said. "I will not tell anyone your secret. Let's solve it together!" He looked around the tree. He saw a long, strong vine hanging down. "Maybe this can help us," Oliver said. Squeaky watched Oliver, feeling a bit brave.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver reassures Squeaky and offers his help. He sees a vine and comes up with a creative solution to get the nuts down.

slides.title: Sharing the Yummy Nuts
slides.text: Oliver held the vine tightly. He gave it a gentle shake. Plop! Plop! Plop! Three big, yummy nuts fell down. Squeaky jumped with joy! "Thank you, Oliver!" he chattered. Oliver picked up the nuts. He gave two shiny nuts to Squeaky. Squeaky hugged his nuts tight.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver successfully shakes the nuts down with the vine. Squeaky is overjoyed, and Oliver shares the nuts with him.

slides.title: Friends Who Trust
slides.text: "You are a very good friend," Squeaky said. He crunched his yummy nut happily. Oliver smiled. "Friends help each other. And friends always trust each other. It makes our friendship strong." They played a fun game of chase. Squeaky felt so happy and safe with Oliver. It was a warm, happy day in Maple Woods.
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky expresses gratitude, and Oliver explains how trust makes friendships strong. They play happily, ending the day on a warm note.
